title: research: minimize BIT borrowing at actual body depth
body:
## Summary

The one-factor stock consumer keeps D(e) and leaves selection at the actual body depth open. This package proves the least borrowing under its existing covering constraint:

```text
fix w before borrowing
n(k) = floor((e-k)/w)
find least k with 2k < e, n(k) >= 64, q^k >= S_D(n(k))
```

The predicate is monotone, so bisection finds its threshold. A separate inverse-depth slab formula gives the same optimum. A selected-domain two-cycle shows why solving k=ceil(log_q S_D(n(k))) by substitution is insufficient.

This is a conditional interface theorem and bounded host-integer selector. It retains q^k>=S, fixed w and all completed-callee/padding/restoration premises. Optimality over different padding budgets is unclaimed. No Count-tape integration, default backend, supplier, cutoff, kappa or selected-frontier change is included.

## Evidence

- **Before:** for q=2^127-1, e=250000 and the existing exact w=2, D(e) needs 147459 borrowed digits and fails strict fit. Even D(floor(e/w)) needs 139267 and fails.
  **After:** actual-body selection needs 122882, leaves n=63559 of depth 15, and satisfies 245764<250000. No payload or runtime measurement is claimed.
- At e=970370,w=2 the exact substitution cycles 155651 -> 163843 -> 155651. The least admitted k is 159747, whose body needs 155651. Exact stock product bounds and a Lucas-Lehmer certificate support these selected-parameter examples.
- Forward bisection and independent inverse-depth slabs agree on 8192 cases and five selected examples. A separate exhaustive k scan checks all 8192 decisions and every accepted padded quotient/Q guard. Nine capacity failures and seven actual optimized CLI rejection controls pass.
- Registered normal/optimized Python 3.12 replay, scoped Ruff/format checks, all 18 committed-byte/source-history comparisons, export integrity and all four Git-free committed-export commands pass. All 19 exported files retain bytes, modes and inodes.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-body-depth-borrowing
python3.12 -W error -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/selected-body-depth-borrowing --check-source-history
```

Base canonical main is 6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c, priority revision 6; submission fetch found no changed guidance. Complete live overlap covered 399 open PR bodies and 2324 Discussion records without warnings. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19010306). Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside that coverage.

Credit Nick Petalas/PR3246, Tekalign/PR3264, Jose Manuel/PR2899/2809, David Arias/PR2753, Ross Richardson/PR2420 and their retained BIT/geometry/assembly lineage. The reserve reduction and existing consumer composition remain their results. Exact source blobs, proof, scope and open next question are in the package.

Unrun obligations include a fixed-role encoded selector and its physical setup invoice, selected GL64 payload execution, full selected cold replay, universal physical/C0 refinement, uniform costs, independent human review and formal proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

Eleven new scoped package files; frozen inputs and shared implementations are unchanged.
